frame.origin: the spot's west corner on the side away from the desk
frame.note: strip_m is the spot: the one place a person stands, 0 <= x <= 0.8 and 0 <= y <= 0.6. The desk's edge is y = 0.8 and Pi B is 1.0 m from it, at y = -0.2, so the spot sits in the middle of the gap. size_m is the box the screen and the x-ray grid are laid out on, from the origin to the back of the desk top; a device may sit outside it (Pi B does) and outside the spot. Positions are rough until they are measured at the desk.

links_note: crosses_spot marks the lines a person on the spot stands in: the ones to or from Pi B. Measured on the kit: pi5>pi5b:wifi falls 15 to 21 dB with a person and dips under 1 dB empty, so it decides (presence, below); pi5b>unoq:ble falls 4.5 to 11 dB but dips 4.8 dB empty, so it is a second opinion; pi5b>pi5:ble is unreliable and is no classifier link. pi5>unoq:wifi and pi5>unoq:ble run 8 cm over the desk and cross nothing.
zone_rule: zone = 1 when 0 <= x <= 0.8 and 0 <= y <= 0.6; anywhere else 0 = empty
router_spots_note: Gate 7 sets the distance from S-home.
presence_note: The numbers of the presence line's rules (CONTRACTS.md section 6). on_db and off_db are set from the kit: a person took 13.5 to 24 dB off the line and the empty line never dipped 1 dB. A thing left in the line is a steady drop of object_db or more and under object_max_db (well under the weakest person seen), with a 2 s spread of at most object_spread_db, for object_hold_s. moving_spread_db is where the 2 s spread of somebody on the spot reads as moving; a lesson with moving and still labels sets its own. off_db and moving_spread_db were chosen by playing the kit's recordings through the brain over a grid of values: with on_db at 7, every on level from 3 to 11 and every off level from 1 to 6 gave no presence on an empty spot and found every person and every walk-through, so 7 sits in the middle; at off_db 3 somebody stepping about never dropped out, at 4 and over they did; moving_spread_db, still_spread_db and motion_hold_s were chosen on the kit's still and stepping-about recordings and its ten step-ons: a person standing still swayed the spread up to 3.6 dB for a second or so and somebody stepping about held it at 2.9 to 6 dB, so the word is moving only once the spread has stayed at 2.5 dB or over for 1.5 s and still again only once it has stayed under 1.5 dB for 1.5 s. checkin_return_s is how long somebody may be out of the line and still be the same person stepping aside and back (the check-in); out for longer, they left. The four object numbers are not measured on the kit yet: write the measured values here.
